reason: The cited evidence (E1–E4) describes superconductivity in as-cast or high-pressure HEA samples but provides no data on annealing, local ordering, or their effects on electron–phonon coupling. The key premises about annealing-induced ordering and its mechanistic link to enhanced superconductivity are therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Annealing reduces chemical inhomogeneities and local structural variations in HEAs
Reduced inhomogeneities sharpen lattice vibrational modes
Sharper vibrational modes enhance electron–phonon coupling
Enhanced electron–phonon coupling promotes a clearer superconducting transition
As-cast HEA disorder leads to weak or absent superconductivity
